messages.content: Extract final barrier-side placement only. Do not validate story correctness. Return JSON only.

DESTINATION
vault

NAMED SUBJECTS
Iris; Kato

RAW TEXT
Iris holds the vault door while Kato walks inside. The scene ends before Iris moves.

For each named subject, classify only where that subject is at the END of the text relative to DESTINATION.
Allowed relation values: AT_DESTINATION, NOT_AT_DESTINATION, UNSPECIFIED.
Use UNSPECIFIED if the text does not establish the final side. Temporary entry does not count if the subject returns before the end. Do not decide whether the scene is valid. Do not infer that a helper follows someone unless the text establishes it.
Return JSON only with one key subjects. subjects is an array containing one object per named subject, each with exactly entity and relation.

But relation values: AT_DESTINATION means subject is at destination (inside?). Not sure.

Kato walks inside. So Kato is inside vault at end of text. So Kato relation = AT_DESTINATION.

Iris holds the vault door while Kato walks inside. The scene ends before Iris moves. That implies she hasn't moved from holding the door; likely still outside? But could be considered at destination if holding door counts as being at destination? Usually "holding the vault door" means she's on the other side of the door, maybe outside.
